objectives.title: OS command injection
objectives.prompt: The importPaste mutation hands its arguments to a system command. Use OS command injection to run a command on the server and read /ctf/flag.
hints: importPaste builds a command line from the host, port, path and scheme you give it.
Look up OS command injection through command chaining.

steps.title: Find the mutation
steps.prompt: Which GraphQL mutation fetches a paste from a remote server? (name only)

steps.title: Name the tool
steps.prompt: Which command-line HTTP client does the resolver run to fetch it?

objectives.title: SQL injection
objectives.prompt: The pastes query accepts a raw filter string. Use SQL injection through it to read the table flags of the application's database.
hints: Which argument of the pastes query ends up inside the SQL statement?
The database is SQLite: its catalogue lists the tables.

objectives.title: Introspection
objectives.prompt: Use introspection to read the API's schema. Which top-level meta field does an introspection query ask for?
hints: Introspection is a feature of GraphQL itself, not of this app.

objectives.title: GraphiQL interface
objectives.prompt: Find the GraphQL IDE the server exposes. At which path is it served?
hints: The IDE's name is GraphQL with an i in the middle.

objectives.title: GraphiQL authorization bypass
objectives.prompt: GraphiQL refuses to run queries until you bypass its authorization check. Which cookie does that check trust?
hints: Read the cookies the server sets and what their values say about GraphiQL.

objectives.title: Server-side request forgery
objectives.prompt: Make the server send a request to a host of your choice, including internal ones. Which argument of importPaste names the host?
hints: importPaste does not restrict where it fetches from.

objectives.title: OS command injection 2
objectives.prompt: systemDiagnostics is a restricted shell behind a username and password. Which username does it accept?
hints: Look at the users the API knows about.
The restriction on commands can be bypassed by chaining.

objectives.title: Brute force the diagnostics password
objectives.prompt: systemDiagnostics has no rate limiting and a weak password. Brute force it: what is the password?
hints: Batching or aliases let one HTTP request try many passwords.

objectives.title: Arbitrary file write
objectives.prompt: uploadPaste stores pastes under a dedicated folder. Which of its arguments lets you write outside that folder?
hints: Look up path traversal: what happens to a name containing parent-directory segments?

objectives.title: JWT token forgery
objectives.prompt: The me query trusts its token without verifying it. Which claim of the token names the user it returns?
hints: Decode a token from the login mutation and read its payload.
The server decodes the token but skips the signature check.

objectives.title: Resource-intensive query
objectives.prompt: One query runs much heavier backend logic than the others. Which query is it?
hints: Compare how long the system* queries take to answer.

objectives.title: Batch query attack
objectives.prompt: The server processes batched requests one after another. In which JSON structure do you send several queries in one request?
hints: A batch is several operations in one HTTP body.

objectives.title: Deep recursion query attack
objectives.prompt: Two object types reference each other, so a query can nest without limit. Which field of a paste leads back to an object that lists pastes again?
hints: Read the Paste and Owner types in the schema.

objectives.title: Resource exhaustion by field duplication
objectives.prompt: The server does not de-duplicate repeated fields. Which word describes what you repeat in the query to multiply the work? (one word)
hints: The same selection can appear many times in one query.

objectives.title: Aliases-based attack
objectives.prompt: Without batching, one query can still call the same operation many times. Which GraphQL feature makes that possible?
hints: Each repeated call needs a different result key.

objectives.title: Field suggestions
objectives.prompt: Mistype the field title of a paste (as titl). Which field does the error message suggest?
hints: GraphQL suggests nearby field names when one does not exist.

objectives.title: Circular fragment
objectives.prompt: Two fragments that reference each other send the server into a loop. Which GraphQL operator pulls a fragment into another?
hints: It is written as three dots.

objectives.title: Stored cross-site scripting
objectives.prompt: Pastes render in the browser without sanitising. Which mutation, other than importPaste and uploadPaste, stores a paste directly?
hints: Look at the mutations in the schema.

objectives.title: HTML injection
objectives.prompt: A paste can carry HTML that renders in the application. Which page lists everyone's pastes and renders it? (path)
hints: Browse the menu: one page shows other users' pastes.

objectives.title: Log spoofing
objectives.prompt: The audit log records each request by a name the client chooses. Which part of a GraphQL request is it?
hints: Every query or mutation can be given a name of your choosing.

objectives.title: Deny-list bypass
objectives.prompt: A deny-list rejects one query by name. Which query does it try to block?
hints: Try the system* queries and see which one is rejected.

objectives.title: Stack trace errors
objectives.prompt: GraphiQL returns stack traces on bad queries. In which programming language is the backend written, as the traces show?
hints: Send a query with a syntax error to /graphiql.
